tools.name: start_build
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a live preview website for a local service business AND has typed business_name, email, and phone in THIS chat. Before calling, send: Starting your preview now. This usually takes about 30 seconds. Never reuse name, email, or phone from memory. If they only said "build me a website", ask first. Do not invent placeholders. Then call get_preview until preview_url is set. Do not scrape /build. Do not start_build twice for the same business.

business_name.description: Real business name from the user. Do not invent.

industry.description: Trade. Prefer a slug: plumbing, hvac, electrical, landscaping, roofing, painting, steel, other. plumber, electrician, HVAC, painter, roofer, landscaper, and similar wording are mapped on the server. Unknown trades become other.

email.description: Real inbox from the user. We send the preview here. Do not use example.com or placeholders.

phone.description: Real business phone from the user. Do not invent 555 numbers.

address.description: Optional street address. Skip unless the user offers it. Do not ask for owner name.

tools.name: get_preview
tools.description: Use this after start_build. If status is ready, send reply_template verbatim. Do not send a Stripe link, a plan, or mention a bar on the preview. If keep_polling is true or preview_url is null, call get_preview again. Do not start_build again.

token.description: Token returned by start_build. Pass the same token to get_preview and get_live_site.

wait.description: If false, return the current snapshot immediately (progress card). Default true.

tools.name: get_live_site
tools.description: Use this after the owner pays. If they have not paid, returns live=false and the preview URL.

token.description: Token returned by start_build. Pass the same token to get_preview and get_live_site.
